column1: # form<TAB>old<TAB>new<TAB>reason. Reviewed lemma changes that tools/make-lexicon.py lets a rebuild make: a form (any form or lemma of the tables on disk) that read as the old lemma and now reads as the new one. A word's saved state and its iCloud record are keyed by its lemma, so each row moves stored data to another key and must give the reason the new lemma is right. Rows stay after the rebuild, as the record of every key that moved. No lemma has changed yet.
